title: Some people have said aging is more a slide into forgetfulne…

sents.en: Some people have said aging is more a slide into forgetfulness than a journey towards wisdom.
sents.cn: 有人曾说，衰老更像是滑向遗忘，而非通向智慧之旅。

sents.en: However, a growing body of research suggests that late-in-life learning is possible.
sents.cn: 然而，越来越多的研究表明，晚年学习是可能的。

sents.en: In reality, education does an aging brain good.
sents.cn: 事实上，教育对衰老的大脑有益。

sents.en: Throughout life, people's brains constantly renovate themselves.
sents.cn: 人的一生中，大脑不断自我更新。

sents.en: In the late 1960s, British brain scientist Geoffrey Raisman spied growth in damaged brain regions of rats through an electron microscope; their brains were forging new connections.
sents.cn: 20世纪60年代末，英国脑科学家杰弗里∙雷斯曼通过电子显微镜观察到老鼠受损脑区的生长；它们的大脑正在建立新的连接。

sents.en: This meant brains may change every time a person learns something new.
sents.cn: 这意味着每当一个人学到新东西，大脑就可能发生改变。

sents.en: Of course, that doesn't mean the brain isn't affected by the effects of time.
sents.cn: 当然，这并非意味着大脑不受时间影响。

sents.en: Just as height usually declines over the years, so does brain volume: Humans lose about 4 percent every decade starting in their 40s.
sents.cn: 正如身高通常随年龄增长而下降，脑容量也是如此：人类从40多岁起每十年约损失4%。

sents.en: But that reduction doesn't necessarily make people think slower; as long as we are alive and functioning, we can alter our brains with new information and experiences.
sents.cn: 但这种减少未必让人思维变慢；只要我们还活着、还在运作，就能用新信息与新经历来改变大脑。

sents.en: In fact, scientists now suspect accumulating novel experiences, facts, and skills can keep people's minds more flexible.
sents.cn: 事实上，科学家现在怀疑，积累新奇的经历、事实和技能能让人的思维更灵活。

sents.en: New pathways can strengthen our ever-changing mental structure, even as the brain shrinks.
sents.cn: 新的神经通路能强化我们不断变化的心理结构，即便大脑在萎缩。

sents.en: Conventional fixes like word puzzles and brain-training apps can contribute to mental durability.
sents.cn: 填字游戏和脑力训练应用这类传统方法有助于保持心智耐久。

sents.en: Even something as simple as taking a different route to the grocery store or going somewhere new on vacation can keep the brain healthy.
sents.cn: 即便是诸如绕路去杂货店或度假去个新地方这样简单的事，也能让大脑保持健康。

sents.en: A desire for new life challenges can further boost brainpower.
sents.cn: 对新生活挑战的渴望能进一步提升脑力。

sents.en: Research about aging adults who take on new enterprises shows improved function and memory as well as a reduced risk of mental disease.
sents.cn: 有关接受新事业的老年人的研究表明，其功能与记忆力改善，患精神疾病的风险也降低。

sents.en: Openness · a characteristic defined by curiosity and a desire for knowledge · may also help folks pass brain tests.
sents.cn: 开放性——一种以好奇心和求知欲为定义的特征——也可能帮助人们通过脑部测试。

sents.en: Some folks are born with this take-in-the-world attitude, but those who aren't as genetically gifted aren't necessarily out of luck.
sents.cn: 有些人天生具备这种处世态度，但那些基因上没这么幸运的人也未必没救。

sents.en: While genes can encourage an interest in doing new things, a 2012 study in the journal Psychology and Aging found completing reasoning tasks like puzzles and number games can enhance that desire for novel experiences, which can, in turn, refresh the brain.
sents.cn: 虽然基因能激发去做新事的兴趣，但2012年《心理学与衰老》期刊的一项研究发现，完成拼图、数字游戏等推理任务能增强对新体验的渴望，而这又能反过来刷新大脑。

sents.en: That's why brain scientist Richard Kennedy says "It's not that old dogs can't learn new tricks.
sents.cn: 正因如此，脑科学家理查德∙肯尼迪说：“不是老狗学不会新把戏，而是老狗也许没意识到为何要学。

sents.en: It's that maybe old dogs don't realize why they should."
